# GitHub Gist

> GitHub Gist is a simple way to share code snippets, notes, and configurations with the community through version-controlled, shareable documents.

GitHub Gist serves as a lightweight code sharing platform where developers can discover, fork, and collaborate on code snippets, templates, and documentation. The platform hosts diverse content ranging from smart home automation templates to AI integration guides and technical references.

## Core Discovery & Navigation

- [GitHub Gist Homepage](https://gist.github.com): GitHub Gist homepage for discovering and sharing code snippets
- [Discover Gists](https://gist.github.com/discover): Discover gists page showcasing community code sharing contributions
- [Starred Gists](https://gist.github.com/starred): Browse starred gists across GitHub community with code snippets
- [Forked Gists](https://gist.github.com/forked): View forked gists with version control and code sharing features

## Getting Started

- [Sign Up for GitHub](https://gist.github.com/join): GitHub account registration and sign-up page with features overview

## Featured Guides & References

- [Complete Guide to Building Claude Skills](https://gist.github.com/liskl/269ae33835ab4bfdd6140f0beb909873): Complete guide to building Claude Skills with YAML reference and fundamentals
- [Manim MCP Integration Setup](https://gist.github.com/AndrewAltimit/c437c9fbc9a72271969127fcbf935561): Manim MCP integration setup guide for mathematical animations
- [Home Assistant Dashboard Templates](https://gist.github.com/EverythingSmartHome/13f14c328669f72eee717752069a0398): Home Assistant dashboard templates with Jinja2 sensor configurations
- [Azure Skills Telemetry Reference](https://gist.github.com/saikoumudi/8b19b6dbcea4ece9eccc35bb42706096): Azure Skills Plugin telemetry tracking and usage metrics reference
